description.fun: A little imp that sneaks into homes to steal things and generally make a nuisance of itself, then sucks up the annoyance it causes through its nose and feeds on it. Without negative feelings to absorb, it gets grumpy. Impidimp live in groups and practise pranks on each other. It may nod to the Lincoln Imp, a carving in Lincoln Cathedral.
description.guide: A small Dark and Fairy-type imp Pokémon that feeds on negative emotions, causing trouble so it can absorb people's frustration. Its line is male-only and draws on imps and goblins from European folklore. It evolves into Morgrem and then Grimmsnarl.
description.tagline: A prankster imp that feeds on your frustration

description.fun: Not confident in its strength, Morgrem fights dirty: it drops to all fours as if begging forgiveness, then stabs with its sickle-shaped hair once its foe lowers their guard. It lures people into the woods, yet some believe it can make crops grow. Its look recalls the redcap, a murderous goblin of English legend.
description.guide: The middle stage of Impidimp's line, a devious goblin-like Pokémon that feigns surrender to lure in opponents before attacking. Morgrem feeds on negative emotions and lures people into its forest.
description.tagline: Begs for mercy, then stabs you with its hair

description.fun: A hulking ogre whose hair works like muscle: wrapped around its body, it boosts Grimmsnarl's strength enough to overpower Machamp, and unfurled, it snares foes like tentacles. Even in this splendid form it can't give up petty pranks. It seems to play the green-skinned 'bad witch' to its counterpart Hatterene's good one.
description.guide: The final evolution of Impidimp, a Dark and Fairy Pokémon whose long hair wraps its body and works like muscle fibre. Based on ogres and trolls, it is the male-only counterpart of Hatterene. It has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A troll whose hair is its muscle

description.fun: Hair sprouts all over its body, its legs twist into drills that bore huge holes in Galar's ground, and it's strong enough to jump over the world's tallest building.
